name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Commission delegated regulation of 1 December 2025 amending Regulation (EU) No 2022/869 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the Union list of projects of common interest and projects of mutual interest
part_text:
The European Parliament is objecting to the European Commission's list of priority energy projects. The list includes gas pipelines, hydrogen infrastructure and CO2 transport, alongside electricity projects. The Parliament says the list should focus on renewable energy and electrification instead. It points to fossil fuel lock-in, environmental harm, corruption risks and high costs. It asks the Commission to withdraw the list and propose a new one that avoids fossil fuel infrastructure and respects climate goals.

- The Commission's list of priority energy projects cannot enter into force as it stands.
- It affects energy project promoters, investors and EU funding decisions.
- The Commission must now propose a new list of projects.
